"""V1-final independent budget checker: hard600 lines per file, hard100 lines per Python function."""

import ast
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path


def check(paths: list[Path]) -> bool:
    if not paths:
        print("FAIL: zero targets")
        return False
    ok = True
    for path in paths:
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        lines = len(text.splitlines())
        print(f"{'PASS' if lines <= 600 else 'FAIL'}: {path}: {lines} lines / hard600")
        ok = ok and lines <= 600
        if path.suffix == ".py":
            for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(text)):
                if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef | ast.AsyncFunctionDef):
                    size = (node.end_lineno or node.lineno) - node.lineno + 1
                    print(f"{'PASS' if size <= 100 else 'FAIL'}:   {path.name}:{node.name}: {size} lines / hard100")
                    ok = ok and size <= 100
    return ok


def boundaries() -> bool:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
        path = Path(folder) / "b.py"
        path.write_text("def f():\n    pass\n" + "# x\n" * 598, encoding="utf-8")
        accept600 = check([path])
        path.write_text("def f():\n    pass\n" + "# x\n" * 599, encoding="utf-8")
        reject601 = not check([path])
        path.write_text("def g():\n" + "    x = 1\n" * 99, encoding="utf-8")
        accept100 = check([path])
        path.write_text("def g():\n" + "    x = 1\n" * 100, encoding="utf-8")
        reject101 = not check([path])
        reject0 = not check([])
    verdicts = {"accept600": accept600, "reject601": reject601, "accept100": accept100, "reject101": reject101, "reject0": reject0}
    print("BOUNDARIES:", verdicts)
    return all(verdicts.values())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if sys.argv[1:] == ["--boundaries"]:
        sys.exit(0 if boundaries() else 1)
    sys.exit(0 if check([Path(p) for p in sys.argv[1:]]) else 1)
